display_long_description:
This is a VR game focused entirely on the act of throwing.  
Instead of shooting or slashing, you fight zombies by throwing.

# Throwing styles
You will be fighting alone in a world overrun by zombies.  
Since your weapon’s damage changes based on how hard you throw, learning how to throw is essential if you want to stay alive.  
Here are some basic throwing styles. Try them out and find the way of fighting that works best for you.  

- Powerful throws: Wind up and throw with all your strength to focus on high single-hit damage.

- Rapid throws: Keep throwing quickly to overwhelm enemies with sheer number of attacks.

- Aimed throws: Carefully aim at distant enemies or weak points to deal damage efficiently.

[media]
# Weapons
With your bullets long gone, the only way to fight is to pick things up and throw them at zombies.  
Here are some of the weapons you can use.

### Baseball
Your basic weapon that can be thrown infinitely.  
You can keep attacking by throwing it one after another, and even bounce it off walls for indirect hits.

### Kitchen timer
A luring item that rings when thrown and draws enemies toward the sound.

### Javelin
A high-powered trump card that can break shields. You don’t have many, but they shine in critical moments.

### Grenade
A weapon for breaking up clusters of enemies at once.  
If you throw it into a tightly packed group, you can change the situation in an instant—but you’ll need to control the strength of your throw so it lands right in the middle instead of flying past them.
